settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Server-wide options, stored in the database

ui.hidePasswordHelper: Only takes effect when at least one OAuth2 provider is configured. Without one, the password form always shows so nobody gets locked out.
ui.hidePasswordHelperWithCount_one: Only takes effect when at least one OAuth2 provider is configured ({{count}} configured). Without one, the password form always shows so nobody gets locked out.
ui.hidePasswordHelperWithCount_other: Only takes effect when at least one OAuth2 provider is configured ({{count}} configured). Without one, the password form always shows so nobody gets locked out.
ui.noProviderWarning: No OAuth2 provider is configured, so the password form still shows on the login page.
ui.oauthAuto: Skip the login page and sign in directly with the provider
ui.oauthAutoHelper: Redirects to the provider automatically when the password form is hidden and exactly one OAuth2 provider is configured. Signing out returns to the login page once.
ui.oauthAutoNoSingleProvider: Auto sign-in only takes effect with exactly one OAuth2 provider configured.

taskType.findBooksWithMissingPageHash: Find books with missing page hash

taskQueue.title: Task queue
taskQueue.waiting: Waiting for the first update… · Updates every 10s
taskQueue.clearBody: Queued tasks that no worker has picked up yet will be removed. Tasks already running are unaffected.

form.rememberMeDurationHelper: How long a “Remember me” login stays valid.
form.thumbnailSizeHelper: Larger thumbnails look sharper but take more disk space.
form.taskPoolSizeHelper: How many background tasks can run at once.
form.skipReadOnNextHelper: In series and read lists, “next book” goes to the first book not finished yet, or to the plain next book when every later one is read. Applies to every client.
form.fixInvalid: Fix the invalid fields above to save.
form.recentReadingDaysHelper: Keep Reading and On Deck only show series read within this period.

rotateKey.done: Key rotated — all "Remember me" logins were signed out.
rotateKey.body: Every user who chose "Remember me" will be signed out and has to log in again on all devices.

regenerate.title: Regenerate thumbnails
regenerate.body: The thumbnail size was changed. Books keep their current thumbnails until they are regenerated — this queues a background task, visible in the task queue panel.
regenerate.failed: Could not queue the regeneration task.

validation.positiveDays: Must be a positive whole number of days.
validation.positiveInt: Must be a positive whole number.

logfile.title: Logfile
logfile.helper: Fetch the current server log as a file.
